connector.name: Bitcoin MCP
connector.registryDescription: 49 Bitcoin tools for AI agents: fees, mempool, blocks, mining, price. Zero config.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package bitcoin-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bortlesboat account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BITCOIN_RPC_PORT
env.description: Bitcoin Core RPC port (default: auto-selected by network)

env.name: BITCOIN_NETWORK
env.description: Bitcoin network: mainnet, testnet, signet, or regtest (default: mainnet). Sets default RPC port if BITCOIN_RPC_PORT is not set.

env.name: SATOSHI_API_URL
env.description: Override the default hosted API URL (default: https://bitcoinsapi.com). The hosted API is used automatically when no local node is detected.

env.name: SATOSHI_API_KEY
env.description: API key for authenticated access to the hosted Satoshi API (get one free at POST /api/v1/register)
